nodes.description: Verify sidecar not from future slot and within finalized range

nodes.label: Verify Proposer Signature
nodes.description: Validate block header signature from expected proposer

nodes.description: Validate Merkle proof of kzg_commitments against body_root at depth 4

nodes.label: Verify Data Column KZG Proofs

sub_graphs.title: Fulu P2P: Data Column Request/Response Protocols
sub_graphs.description: Models the req/resp protocols for fetching data column sidecars by range and by root

nodes.label: DataColumnSidecarsByRange Request Received
nodes.description: Peer requests data columns for slot range [start_slot, start_slot + count) with specified column indices

nodes.label: Validate Range Request Parameters
nodes.description: Check start_slot and count within data_column_serve_range and request size within limits

nodes.label: Serve Data Column Range Response
nodes.description: Return sidecars for requested range, must include at least first blob-carrying block

nodes.label: DataColumnSidecarsByRoot Request Received
nodes.description: Peer requests specific data columns by block_root and column indices

nodes.label: Validate Root Request Parameters
nodes.description: Check block_root since minimum_request_epoch and request count within MAX_REQUEST_BLOCKS_DENEB

nodes.label: Serve Data Column Root Response
nodes.description: Return matching data column sidecars for requested roots and column indices

nodes.label: Response Sent to Peer
nodes.description: Requested data columns sent back to requesting peer

nodes.label: Resource Unavailable Error
nodes.description: Requested data not available, return error code 3

ambiguities.text: The specification states peers 'SHOULD query engine_getBlobsV2 as soon as they receive a valid beacon block' but does not define what happens if the engine call fails or returns partial data.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume nodes fall back to P2P gossip for data columns if engine_getBlobsV2 fails. This is an assumption.

ambiguities.text: The distinction between REJECT and IGNORE for various gossip validation failures is not always clear, particularly for timing-related failures.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume IGNORE for timing issues (future slots) and REJECT for cryptographic/structural failures. This is an assumption.

ambiguities.text: DataColumnSidecarsByRange must return 'at least the data column sidecars of the first blob-carrying block' but it's unclear what 'first' means if the range starts at an empty slot.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume 'first blob-carrying block' means the first block in the range that contains any blobs. This is an assumption.

implicit_assumptions.description: An attacker cannot control enough custody groups to withhold all copies of a data column from the network.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Data availability could be compromised, allowing blocks with unavailable blob data to be finalized.

implicit_assumptions.description: Sufficient supernodes (>= 4096 ETH stakers) exist to provide full data availability and reconstruction capabilities.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Network could lose reconstruction capability, making data recovery impossible after partial column loss.

implicit_assumptions.description: The KZG trusted setup ceremony produced valid parameters that no party can exploit.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Forged KZG proofs could pass verification, allowing invalid blob data to be accepted as valid.
